title: Causal memory × blind learned addressing × selective execution integration
question: Can a model preserve a target fact amid competing writes, retrieve it without privileged addresses, and solve an exact held-out task with end-to-end work below exhaustive full-history execution?
prior_evidence: ADDRESS-003 37869867957 bounded pooled pass, condition-level deficits remain
PERSISTENCE-002 37865476305 bounded pass, no-write arm equally accurate

protocol.task: Each episode stores multiple independently addressed same-format facts. A final query identifies one earlier target identity without revealing its slot; output is target value XOR a new current query bit. Each paired history has byte-identical current/distractor observations, but opposite target fact values.
protocol.controls_for_target: Randomize target position, keys and payload independently; balance paired targets; hold current/distractor observations and query fixed within pair; make target-independent distractor writes hard and potentially confusable.
protocol.corruption: held-out structured and isotropic channels; no channel identifier in model inputs; per-condition results mandatory
protocol.split: disjoint train and evaluation seeds/namespaces, episode fingerprints and item keys; no hidden selection by evaluation
protocol.executor: non-oracle fixed validated exact operation control; not the unvalidated Generic CASM-001 learned operator
protocol.accounting: Measured routing, retrieval, retained write, execution, verification; report indexing/build/update separately and account amortized total query cost; report dense similarity scans as O(H), not sublinear
protocol.timing: execution wall-time and CPU-time reported as diagnostics, never used alone to assert complexity
protocol.independence: Oracle arm may use targets only inside benchmark-side evaluator, not learned model, address scorer, or execution inputs

integrity_gates: every evaluated input and output schema audited for answer/slot/target/phase/channel leakage
target position uniform and payload independent
same-format competing writes and actual GRU writes counted; gradients nonzero and state updates measured
every pair has identical current, distractors and query with complementary target label
reset within paired histories is exactly 0.5 and oracle upper bound is validated
disjoint key/episode pools and unique held-out fingerprints
learned scorer genuinely parameter-updated, permutation equivariant, no inference-time condition labels
target satisfier unique and actual pipeline can realize target
fresh benchmark/runner/contract/source hashes and artifact provenance
raw per-episode outcomes sufficient for independent validator to rederive every success metric and work counter
model has no access to control-arm oracle values
all eight arms, seeds, levels and primary cells present

thresholds.work_cost_units: count measured primitive multiply-add, comparator and memory read/write operations; both arms use identical counting rules
thresholds.note: The memory-interference drop is diagnostic only, not a success criterion; a zero drop must not be represented as useful write processing.

decision_rule.condition: Every integrity gate passes and all 7 named joint primary thresholds pass on frozen evaluated cells and seed bootstrap
decision_rule.licenses: Bounded positive integrated synthetic causal memory + retrieval + selective execution evidence with stated work accounting
decision_rule.does_not_license: General AGI, semantic long-term memory, arbitrary computation, or sublinear total complexity if address stage still scans H

decision_rule.condition: Integrity passes but at least one joint primary threshold fails
decision_rule.licenses: Measured partial/negative result with all arms and cells reported

decision_rule.condition: Any leakage, representability, provenance, benchmark, missing arm, metric, or raw-validator gate fails

dependencies.addressing: PR #141 then #152, do not cherry-pick unreviewed frozen results

interpretation_order: all frozen primary cells and per-condition floors
registration_note: This file is committed before any INTEGRATION-001 implementation or measurement. Thresholds may not be adapted to measured outcomes; implementation must validate this machine-readable contract.
